howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 接上 Resend 邮件通道:复制并注册适配器、装固定版本依赖、构建并跑注册测试,把 API key 等凭据写入 .env,再把你设为 owner 并发出第一封问候邮件。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加 Resend 邮件通道,或想通过邮件与 agent 异步对话时接管;在 /setup 流程中也可调用。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 加上 Resend 邮件通道
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑构建和测试

say.text: 把我的邮箱 me@example.com 设为 owner,并发封问候邮件给我
say.note: 注册你并发出第一封邮件线程

say.text: 邮件通道装好了但收不到回复,帮我排查
say.note: 会检查 webhook 与签名密钥配置

howto.what_en: Claude adds a Resend email channel to NanoClaw: it copies and registers the adapter, installs the pinned package, builds and runs the registration test, writes the API key to .env, then wires you as owner and sends a hello email.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a Resend email channel to NanoClaw or talk to an agent over email; it can also run during /setup.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, builds and tests

say_en.text: Set my address me@example.com as owner and email me a hello.
say_en.note: Registers you and sends the hello thread

say_en.text: The channel is installed but replies never arrive - help me debug.
say_en.note: Checks the webhook and signing secret
